strips.title: A new stand mixer in its first week: in real life

panels.head: Before you buy
panels.text: Measure under the cabinets and count your biggest batch. That picks the size.

panels.head: Day one
panels.text: Read the model number on the box. Then do the dime test before the first batch.

panels.head: First bread
panels.text: Speed 2 only, and split a stiff dough. A bouncing head means too much dough.

panels.head: Day 30
panels.text: Leaking grease or a grinding gear? It is still inside the return window.
